marks.q: As the Company advances South Crofty towards construction, securing the project financing required to support full project development will be a key priority in 2026.

This update is provided in accordance with the terms of the Company’s senior secured bond issued on 21 May 2026 and is not intended to introduce new material information; further detail on the matters referenced is set out in the Company’s previous announcements.

The near-term priority remains to complete the project financing package for South Crofty, which is well advanced. Alongside that, dewatering continues towards the 400-level which is targeted to be reached in the first half of 2027, with shaft refurbishment and mine dewatering also scheduled for completion in that period.

Refurbishment of NCK shaft continues, with the rate of progress increasing over recent months. Dewatering and shaft refurbishment are tracking to reach 400-level (approximately 730 metres below surface) in H1 2027.

Dewatering continued through the New Cook’s Kitchen (“NCK”) shaft, reaching more than 400 metres below surface by mid-October, with the rate of shaft refurbishment increasing; the 400-level (approximately 730 metres below surface) is targeted to be reached in H1 2027 as previously guided
